description: This file defines functions and types for generating and managing preview properties for component schemas in a document editor, including handling array keys, schema memoization, and nested preview property creation.

methods.name: getKeysForArrayValue
methods.description: Retrieves or generates unique keys for array values, caching them in a WeakMap.

methods.name: setKeysForArrayValue
methods.description: Associates a set of element IDs with a specific array value.

methods.name: getNewArrayElementKey
methods.description: Generates a new unique string key for array elements.

methods.name: getOrInsert
methods.description: Retrieves a value from a map or inserts it if absent.

methods.name: createGetPreviewProps
methods.description: Main function that creates a function to generate preview properties for component schema values, handling nested schemas and memoization.
